findings.title: N+1 data-access amplification (query inside loop) [DATA-QUERY-IN-LOOP]
findings.impact: Can degrade latency/throughput or exhaust resources as load grows.
findings.explanation: A database/network query executes inside a loop body — O(N) round-trips instead of one batched fetch. Detected in C:\Users\User\Downloads\BUSINESS\INFRASTRUCTURE\recourse\src\lib\v5\skilltechBridge.ts:177.
findings.suggestedVerification: Batch the fetch outside the loop (WHERE id IN (...)) or use a collection query that returns all rows at once.

findings.title: Validation before canonicalization (CWE-179/180/181) [CANON-VALIDATE-BEFORE-NORMALIZE]
findings.impact: Could expose or corrupt protected data or grant unauthorized access.

findings.suggestedVerification: Normalize (trim/decode/lowercase) FIRST, then validate the canonical value.

findings.explanation: Promise.all maps every element into a concurrent task with no concurrency cap — DB/network pool exhaustion or OOM under growth. Detected in C:\Users\User\Downloads\BUSINESS\INFRASTRUCTURE\recourse\src\skills\scanner.ts:245.
findings.suggestedVerification: Use a bounded pool (p-queue, async-mutex semaphore) or batch the work into fixed-size chunks.

findings.title: Integer overflow beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER [NUM-OVERFLOW]

findings.suggestedVerification: Use BigInt or a bignum library for values that can exceed MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and validate bounds.
